titles.title: The Black Dog of St. John's

description:
**Is it a human hand, or a beast’s paw?**

Adriel Merryweather, the only son of a low-status and fading family, transfers into “St. John’s,” one of the most prestigious boarding schools, after a grueling amount of effort.

While he enrolled to fulfill his parents’ expectations of restoring their declining household, he had an even more crucial purpose: to expose the true identity of a student at the school, Jeremiah Washburn, as a demon in the shape of a black dog.

*“Long time no see. It’s good to see you.”*

However, right on his very first day at school, Adriel has an unexpected reunion with Jeremiah—and commits a terrible mistake in front of everyone...
